cohort: 788,317 singleton births in Finland between 1997 and 2010
finding: High socioeconomic status, advanced maternal age, and depression were identified as risk factors for fear of childbirth, while among multiparous women, previous caesarean section also increased the risk.
mod_finding: Fear of childbirth was associated with a higher rate of caesarean section in both nulliparous and multiparous women.
